objective: Implement and verify a durable deterministic background runtime with scheduling, waiting, owner input, retry, event, and restart recovery infrastructure.
acceptanceCriteria: A long-running service and replaceable local persistence layer survive clean and interrupted restarts.
The durable queue supports every required task state, scheduling, fixed-interval recurrence, pause/resume, dependencies, and bounded retry backoff.
Condition and model waits use modular deterministic checks without consuming LLM or coding-harness tokens while waiting.
Owner-dependent tasks persist an explicit ownerInputRequired value and cannot resume without supplied input.
Important runtime events are persisted and exposed through an internal listener interface.
Interrupted RUNNING and VERIFYING tasks recover safely without corrupting the runtime snapshot.
Private runtime data is local and excluded from Git.
M00–M02 tests, typecheck, lint, all runtime tests, and focused M03 acceptance checks pass.
notes: M03 uses an atomic JSON snapshot behind a replaceable store interface; no external database server is required.
One service process owns a runtime directory in M03.
Waiting is ordinary software and must not invoke any model or harness.
nextAction: Implement the runtime model, store, engine, service lifecycle, CLI, and comprehensive restart-oriented acceptance tests.
